home.title: AeleOS
home.body: One account for every app in the community. Sign in once and you are already signed in everywhere.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.subtitle: Use the account you already have.
signIn.error: We could not open that option. Please try again.

profile.platformIdHint: This ID is the same in every Furry Colombia app.
profile.addressHint: This is where your public profile lives. Share it, or open it to see what others see.

fursonas.title: Your pages
fursonas.subtitle: The characters you can act as across Furry Colombia.
fursonas.suspended: Your account is suspended, so your fursonas are not available right now and no new ones can be created. Nothing has been deleted.

form.handleHint: Letters, digits, dash and underscore. This is how the fursona is addressed.

errors.handle: Use 1–32 letters, digits, dashes or underscores.
errors.handleTaken: You already have a fursona with that handle.
errors.handleRetired: You had that handle before and gave it up. It cannot be used again.
errors.displayName: Keep this to 64 characters or fewer.
errors.avatarUrl: Enter an http or https image address, or leave it empty.
errors.limitReached: You already have the maximum number of fursonas.
errors.sectionsRefused: Your sections were refused. Fix them and save again — nothing else was lost.
errors.pageUnreadable: We could not read this page, so nothing was saved — saving now would replace it with nothing. Nothing has been changed.
errors.sections: Your page was not saved. What needs fixing is marked below — every piece of content needs a title in English.
errors.sectionsMarked: Your page was not saved. What needs fixing is marked below.
errors.sectionsTooLarge: Your page holds more than it can. Take something off it and save again — nothing was lost.

fursonas.writingInHint: Only the name and the page text below — not the app itself.
fursonas.sectionsEmpty: No sections yet. Add one to start building the page.
fursonas.sectionsAtLimit: You have reached the maximum this page can hold.
fursonas.dragInstructions: Press the space bar to pick this up, the arrow keys to move it, the space bar again to drop it, or escape to leave it where it was.
fursonas.dragRefusedIntoItself: That would put a section inside itself, so nothing moved.
fursonas.dragRefusedTooDeep: That is one level deeper than a page can go, so nothing moved.
fursonas.dragRefusedNoSuchPlace: That place is no longer there, so nothing moved.
fursonas.sectionStyleBackgroundUrlHint: Paste an address. Nothing is stored.
fursonas.styleChromeHint: Takes away the fill, the edge and the padding, so the content sits on the page itself.
fursonas.styleHeadingBar: As a bar on top of it
fursonas.sectionStyleBorderHint: The edge around this section's own cards and panels.
fursonas.imageUrlHint: Paste a link to a picture. Nothing is uploaded — it stays wherever you host it.
fursonas.linkUrlHint: A YouTube, Spotify, Telegram, Instagram, X or similar link plays or embeds here. Anything else becomes a link or a chip.
fursonas.linkUrlPlainHint: This becomes a button or a chip — nothing plays or embeds here.
fursonas.templateConfirm: This replaces the sections you have now. What you wrote will be gone.

reference-sheet.name: Reference sheet
reference-sheet.description: The facts an artist asks for: species, pronouns, age, and how the design works.

character-story.name: Character story
character-story.description: Who they are and where they came from, with room for the small details.

art-gallery.name: Art gallery
art-gallery.description: Somewhere to show the pictures, with credit to whoever drew them.

fursuit.name: Fursuit
fursuit.description: The suit itself — who built it, what of, and where it has been.

fursonas.themeCanvasGroupHint: It moves behind your page, under everything you write.
fursonas.themeAdjusted: Your accent, as visitors see it
fursonas.themeCursorHint: A link to a small picture — 128×128 or less, or browsers ignore it.
fursonas.themeCursorTooBig: That picture is bigger than 128×128, so browsers will ignore it.
fursonas.themeBackgroundUrlHint: A link to a picture. Nothing is stored, and it sits over your gradient.
fursonas.sectionSpacesHint: How many places sit side by side. Fewer means more rows — nothing you have put here is removed.
fursonas.sectionWeightsHint: These set how wide each place is next to the others. When there is little room they even out, and on a narrow screen the places stack in the order they are in here.
fursonas.nestingAtLimit: Sections cannot be nested any deeper than this.

text.title: Heading
text.hint: What do you want to say here?

progress.title: Label
progress.hint: A number, a percentage, or one out of another — 60, 60%, 3/5

fursonas.problemTitle: This needs a title in English before the page can be saved.
fursonas.problemGeneric: Something here was refused. Check this block's fields.
fursonas.removeLocked: Your page must keep this — it is the only one left.
fursonas.sectionStyleBleed: Reach both edges of the window

picker.title: Who do you want to be?
picker.subtitleFor: {app} is asking which of your identities to continue with.
picker.subtitleGeneric: Choose which of your identities to continue with.
picker.refusedHint: The app that sent you here did not give a destination we recognise, so there is nowhere safe to return you to. Nothing has changed about your account.
picker.cancel: Not now — go back without choosing

notFound.title: We could not find that page
notFound.body: The address may be mistyped, or what was here is no longer available.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: We could not load your identity. This is a problem on our side, not with your account — your sign-in is unaffected.
